summary.text: Nate Davidson is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 103 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously worked as a legislative staffer in the Pennsylvania House.

paragraphs.text: Nate Davidson was born in Pennsylvania and earned a bachelor's degree from Messiah College in 2011.
His career experience includes working as a legislative staffer, and he has been affiliated with Capital Region Water.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives in midtown Harrisburg and had worked in the House of Representatives for five years, first as floor manager to the Democratic caucus and then as senior advisor to the chair of the House Appropriations Committee.
Davidson succeeded Patty Kim, assuming office in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives on December 1, 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Capitol Preservation Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026, and faces Republican Cindi Ward in the general election.
